summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Overall disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, affiliate, or advertising monetization. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; do not send rights outreach or change the gate without human counsel review and owner authorization. Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, attribution, images, prices, freshness, correction, takedown, affiliate, or advertising rights; public terms restrict commercial/public listing use. Fleet compliance is mixed at 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, reject-control, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims.

SearchWoot launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced closed and all 4 remain open. Existing evidence is partial: source-rights baseline is documented but does not establish permission; data-flow evidence is partial; consent and analytics evidence is partial; public terms are draft-only. Close no task without direct evidence. Next evidence actions: attach a field-level Woot rights matrix; produce the alert-data retention/deletion/access table; capture deployed consent behavior plus GA4 property and data-sharing settings; inventory log fields, vendors, retention, incident handling, and data-request procedures.

Woot deal and price-history data: blocked pending authoritative rights and field-level permission. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed pending data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access, processor terms, consent, and unsubscribe evidence. GA4: conditional only for explicit-consent measurement, pending deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional counsel review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. No public sharing, affiliate, advertising, remarketing, or monetization use is approved.

Keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only. Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net unlaunched and preview-only until each has a dated readiness packet covering ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundaries, rollback, and an explicit launch decision. Analytics gaps alone do not block ordinary growth, but these gated sites lack the required concrete launch evidence; do not publish or monetize them.
